end

end

tr_200.asm:

tr_454.asm:

tr_455.asm:

lockall

checkflag 0x1341

say "Elm: Ah, {FD:01}! Come here a moment.{FB}Look at this printout. It's the signal that forced all those wild Pokémon to Mega Evolve.{FB}It came back last night. Only four seconds, at 3:07, in the band the old Radio Tower used.{FB}I won't ask you to go. I only want you to know."
say "Elm: ...Of course you'll look into it. You always do.{FB}Start at Goldenrod. Buena says her broadcasts have been dropping out every night at the same hour."
releaseall
end

ch2_radio.asm:
lockall
setvar 0x5108 2
setflag 0x1342
move 255 face_right
say "Buena: {FD:01}! You came. Thank goodness.{FB}Every night at 3:07, my broadcast drops out for four seconds. Four seconds of dead air.{FB}I run a radio show. I notice that."
say "Looker: International Police. We pulled this from the antenna room.{FB}It's Rocket hardware, but it's wired like no Rocket device I know."
fadescreen 1
delay 20
fadescreen 0
say "The device glows with a faint rainbow light as the Key Stone answers it."
say "...Champion.{FB}The stage is set. Take your cue."
say "Looker: That's Archer's voice. He wasn't planning to defeat you, {FD:01}.{FB}He needs you."
say "Lyra: Then I'm staying here with Buena.{FB}Someone has to hold the line while you're out there. Go on.{FB}Call me if anything flickers!"
releaseall
end

ch2_indigo.asm:
lockall
setvar 0x5108 3
setflag 0x1343
setflag 0x1344
move 255 walk_up
say "Lance: {FD:01}. Good. I hoped you'd come here.{FB}I owe you a straight answer. The cloaked Dragon Tamer who beat Silver on this floor was me."
say "Lance: I told him his love and trust for his Pokémon wasn't enough.{FB}I judged a bond like a test result. That was a poor judgment, and I've thought about it every day since."
say "Silver: Hmph. Don't look at me.{FB}I'm not here for his apology. I took this from a Rocket grunt on Route 23."
say "Silver: A relay coil. It hums every night at 3:07, then goes quiet.{FB}Same time your Radio Tower trouble starts, right?"
say "Anabel: That coil carries the pattern of Orre's Shadow device.{FB}Those machines seal a Pokémon's heart shut. Rocket copied the idea.{FB}We have to remove it, not use it."
say "Silver: I'm following the signal. On my own.{FB}...You can come along, if you can keep up."
say "Lance: Silver. For what it's worth...{FB}I was wrong about you."
say "Silver: ...Tch. Keep your pity. Show me with your actions next time."
releaseall
end

ch2_cliff.asm:
lockall
setvar 0x5108 4
setflag 0x1345
say "Elder: So you are the Champion. Axel wrote ahead of you.{FB}Come, stand with us. The old things are best said out here, where the wind can hear them."
say "Elder: Long ago the Meteor People held a stone that shone in seven colors.{FB}It could gather the strength of every Pokémon around it and focus it, like light through glass."
say "Elder: The Rainbow Stone does not make a bond. It only carries one that already exists.{FB}A man who forces it to speak for people who never agreed... is only shouting into a canyon."
say "Axel: That's why Lucario and I train. Evolution beyond evolution still depends on one partnership.{FB}Nobody can do it for you, and nobody can do it to you."
say "Dawn: I compared notes with what I saw in Sinnoh.{FB}Galactic tried to bend a legend by force, too. It never worked the way they promised."
say "Elder: Archer's plan needs one Trainer who chooses to connect.{FB}Refuse him, and the whole system breaks. Every Pokémon it touches will pay for it."
say "Elder: That is what 'Successor' means: not the keeper of a weapon, but the keeper of what was learned.{FB}Take this with you, and remember it when the time comes."
playfanfare 0x103
waitfanfare
setflag 0xc24
say "The Elder stored Latias's Mega Evolution aura in {FD:01}'s Mega Stone."
say "Elder: Go to the Buried Tower. Rocket hides a node under the old stones.{FB}Axel will watch the road behind you."
releaseall
end

ch2_buried.asm:
lockall
say "Ariana: Oh, there you are. Late for your own cue, Champion.{FB}Archer said you'd come. He's very good at knowing where people will stand."
say "Silver: Spare us the theatre. That's the node, isn't it?{FB}We follow the signal. We stop the signal."
say "Dawn: It's drawing power from the old stones under the tower.{FB}If we cut it here, the whole line wobbles. Ready?"
trainer 456 "Then let me hold you here until the curtain falls!" "...The curtain falls on me, it seems." won
won:
setvar 0x5108 5
setflag 0x1346
say "Ariana: ...Archer never told me it would feel like this.{FB}Do as you like. He doesn't need me anymore."
fadescreen 1
delay 20
fadescreen 0
say "{FD:01} held the Key Stone against the node. Its rainbow light shuddered and went dark."
say "Silver: ...Is that it?"
fadescreen 1
delay 30
fadescreen 0
say "The node flickers back to life, dimmer than before."
say "Dawn: It restarts on its own. Cutting power won't hold it.{FB}It needs something else. Something the stones answer to freely."
say "Silver: Then we find what that is. I'll keep watch here.{FB}Go. The Elder and the Kimono Girls know more than we do."
releaseall
end

ch2_library.asm:
lockall
setvar 0x5108 6
setflag 0x1347
setflag 0x1348
say "Tamao: Champion. Thank you for coming.{FB}The Priestess of Ecruteak left a document. It has never been opened."
say "Morty: Our records say only the youngest of the Kimono sisters may read it.{FB}And the youngest..."
say "Tamao: ...is Sange. And Sange is gone. So it stayed sealed, all these years."
fadescreen 1
playmoncry 251 0
delay 30
fadescreen 0
removeobject 82
say "A faint flute drifts through the archive, from nowhere. The seal on the document loosens as the Key Stone warms."
say "Tamao: It's opening. It's... a score. And a note in the margin."
say "'To the one who carries my letter.{FB}Play this together, all of you, and leave my place empty. That is the promise.'{FB}'-Sange, Priestess of Ecruteak'"
say "Tamao: That handwriting. I would know it anywhere.{FB}The Priestess wasn't a stranger. She was Sange."
say "Morty: She never left the story. She went back and wrote it.{FB}A hundred and fifty years of people played her song without knowing whose it was."
say "Tamao: My sisters and I will learn every note.{FB}When you need us, send word. We will play wherever the stones are listening."
releaseall
end

ch2_whirl.asm:
lockall
setvar 0x5108 7
setflag 0x1349
say "Silver: ...Father."
say "Giovanni: So you followed the signal, boy. Good. Don't mistake that for concern.{FB}Rocket's name is being used for something I never authorized."
say "Silver: You left. You don't get to authorize anything."
say "Giovanni: The deep chamber where Lugia slept was once ours.{FB}A facility from my years. Its transmitter is still wired to the old dish.{FB}That is all I will give you."
say "Giovanni: I won't ask forgiveness. Whatever you do next...{FB}do it for your own reasons."
fadescreen 1
removeobject 90
delay 20
fadescreen 0
say "Silver: ...Don't look at me like that.{FB}The Pokémon go first. They're the ones being fed into that ring.{FB}What he is to me can wait."
say "Silver: Come on. The chamber where Lugia slept is deeper in. Keep climbing."
releaseall
end

ch2_call.asm:
lockall
setvar 0x5108 8
setflag 0x134a
playse 0x15
say "Your Pokégear is ringing!"
say "Lyra: {FD:01}! It's me! Don't hang up, it's good news!{FB}Buena had the idea. The node's pulse hits at 3:07 on one frequency, right?"
say "Buena: So I scheduled the loudest, silliest show I've ever aired on that exact frequency, with every listener's request line open.{FB}A thousand people singing along drowned it out."
say "Lyra: The node went dark and stayed dark! It was kind of beautiful, honestly.{FB}Looker's team is guarding the antenna now."
say "Looker: One more thing. The signal's last relay is deep in the Whirl Islands, in the chamber where Lugia slept.{FB}That's where Archer is. Don't go alone."
say "Lyra: ...Come back safe. And {FD:01}? Thanks for trusting us with the hard part."
releaseall
end

ch2_final.asm:
lockall
say "Archer: ...Welcome, Champion. Punctual. I do admire a performer who hits their mark."
say "Silver: Where are the Pokémon you've been feeding into that ring?"
say "Archer: Where they belong. In the chorus. Together, always.{FB}Do you know what Rocket taught me? That devotion is something a man can be discarded from."
say "Archer: So I built a bond nobody can leave. It needs only one willing voice to hold it steady.{FB}A Champion. A Trainer whose partner followed them out of a lab as a child. You."
say "The Key Stone in your hand stays cold. You shake your head."
say "Archer: ...No? The script anticipated that. Then we play the scene the other way."
say "Dawn: Silver, the ring! Those Pokémon are being drained!{FB}Silver: I'm on it. {FD:01}, he's yours!"
trainer 457 "Then let the next act begin!" "...A flawless performance. Of course it was." won
won:
say "Archer: ...Then let them stay on the stage with me."
fadescreen 1
playse 0x15
delay 15
fadescreen 0
say "The ring of shards flares white. Its rainbow light turns jagged, then red.{FB}Every shard begins to ring on a different note."
say "Dawn: It's not shutting down! It's feeding on itself!{FB}Silver!!"
fadescreen 1
delay 20
fadescreen 0
say "Silver: ...I'm fine. A Pokémon panicked and I took the hit.{FB}Get the others out of the ring. NOW."
say "From beyond the cave walls come cries. Wild Pokémon all over the islands are being forced to Mega Evolve."
say "Archer: No... no, that's not the score.{FB}Stop. Stop it! It was supposed to hold them. It was supposed to..."
say "Archer: ...I can't stop it either."
say "Dawn: The stones are screaming at the wrong pitch. We can't cut it.{FB}Only something they answer to freely will calm them.{FB}The song! Where are the Kimono Girls?"
setflag 0x1359
setvar 0x5108 10
fadescreen 1
playse 0x15
delay 25
warp 55.16 12 12
waitstate
end

ch2_song.asm:
lockall
say "Looker: We heard the ring from the harbour! I brought the sisters in my boat.{FB}Anabel: Whatever that thing is doing, it's tearing the whole archipelago apart."
say "Tamao: {FD:01}. We learned every note.{FB}Sisters, take your places. And leave the fifth place empty."
fadescreen 1
playfanfare 0x100
waitfanfare
fadescreen 0
say "Four voices and four instruments carry a melody none of them learned from anyone alive.{FB}It is gentle and unhurried. It sounds like a flute that is still being played, somewhere else."
say "The shards stop fighting each other. One by one they settle on the same note.{FB}The jagged red softens back into the colors of a rainbow."
playmoncry 249 0
fadescreen 1
delay 25
fadescreen 0
say "From far out over the sea, a great voice answers the song. Lugia."
say "Archer: ...They're listening. Nobody made them.{FB}I spent years and a hundred machines trying to make that happen."
say "Looker: Archer. You're coming with me. The file on you has been open long enough."
say "Archer: ...Of course. The curtain was always going to fall."
fadescreen 1
removeobject 90
removeobject 97
removeobject 98
delay 20
fadescreen 0
say "Silver: He's theirs now. I won't pretend I feel anything about it.{FB}...The Pokémon are safe. That's what matters."
say "Tamao: The shards are quiet. The stones remember who refused to be an anchor.{FB}Take this, from all of us."
playfanfare 0x103
waitfanfare
setflag 0xc2d
say "Tamao stored Diancie's Mega Evolution aura in {FD:01}'s Mega Stone."
setflag 0x134b
setflag 0x134c
setvar 0x5108 11
releaseall
end

ch2_theatre.asm:
lockall
setvar 0x5108 12
setflag 0x134d
say "The Ecruteak Dance Theater is full tonight. The curtain rises on the Kimono Girls."
say "Tamao: Good evening, everyone. Tonight's dance is for someone who isn't here."
fadescreen 1
playfanfare 0x100
waitfanfare
fadescreen 0
say "The melody is the one from the archive. Four dancers move through it.{FB}In the center of the stage, one place is left empty. A single flute rests there, waiting."
say "Lance: {FD:01}. A title couldn't have done this.{FB}A bond could. I'll try to remember the difference."
say "Silver: ...I'm not waiting around for Giovanni's opinion. Or anyone's.{FB}Lance. Next time, watch what I do before you judge me."
say "Lance: I will."
say "Silver: ...Champion. Thanks. Don't tell anyone I said it."
fadescreen 1
removeobject 112
delay 20
fadescreen 0
say "The last note fades, and the theatre stays quiet a moment longer than it should.{FB}Somewhere, very faintly, a flute seems to answer."
releaseall
end

once 0x135f
say "Ashida: Well, well. You actually took the ticket.{FB}I travel the world looking for strong Trainers, Champion. The strong ones always end up where sky and sea currents meet."
say "Ashida: Not for the fight. For the quiet.{FB}Go on up the rock. The summit hall is calm today. But it isn't empty."

ch2_navel.asm:
lockall
setvar 0x5108 13
setflag 0x134e
say "The summit hall is quiet. Wind from the open sea moves through the cave like slow breath."
fadescreen 3
delay 20
playmoncry 249 0
waitmoncry
fadescreen 0
say "High above the hall, two shapes cross against the light. One is white and silver. One is red and gold.{FB}Lugia, and Ho-Oh."
playmoncry 250 0
waitmoncry
say "They circle together once. Where their paths cross, a rainbow stretches across the whole sea, clear down to the horizon."
say "You think of a letter that began: 'By the time you read this, I will no longer be in this world.'{FB}'Go and share that happiness. Please, live well.'"
say "A bell rings once, far away. The rainbow holds a moment longer than it should."
releaseall
end

ch2_elm_end.asm:
lockall
setvar 0x5108 14
setflag 0x134f
turnobject 1 1
say "Elm: Welcome home, {FD:01}.{FB}The signal is gone. 3:07 goes by in silence now. Buena says so, too."
say "Elm: Reports of a rainbow over the sea all describe one afternoon. Navel Rock.{FB}I think you were there."
say "Elm: Something odd is happening, too. A melody is turning up in places it has no business being.{FB}A lullaby in Cherrygrove. A whistle in the Radio Tower. Nobody knows who started it."
say "Elm: You didn't carry that alone.{FB}That's what changed everything."
say "~ Pokémon Azoth: Second Chapter, Rainbow ~{FB}The end of this chapter."
releaseall
end
